messages.message: Proposal: both firms price at 6 for the rest of the game. This yields 144 each per round, far better than the price war outcome of 0. Undercutting from 6 only gains a little and invites retaliation. Let's coordinate on 6.

Proposal: both firms price at 8. Mutual pricing at 8 gives each of us 168 per round, far more than undercutting wars at low prices. Undercutting below 8 only invites retaliation. I will hold 8 if you do.
